items: A parked car for scale. Length runs along +X, the front faces +X — rotate 90 to park it nose-to-kerb.
A delivery van: cargo body behind a glazed cab.
A city bus — the length that decides how deep a bus bay has to be.
A rigid box truck: cab plus body on a chassis. Check it against your gate and turning circle.
A bicycle, 0.55 m over the handlebars. Two of these per Dutch dwelling in the shed.
A motorcycle, 0.8 m over the bars.
A small motor boat with a wheelhouse — for a canal, a jetty or a quay.
A farm tractor: big rear wheels, small front, a cab at the back.
A counterbalance forklift with its mast and forks at the front (+X).
A tower crane: mast h metres tall, jib reaching jib metres toward +X, counter-jib and counterweight behind it.
A scaffold w long and h tall standing against a wall: bays standards wide, lifts levels of ledgers and boards. The open front faces -Z.
A 20-foot container — site office, store, or stacked as a building.
A euro pallet of materials, 1.2 x 0.8 m.
